suggestions: I'm grateful for the CI pipeline going green on the first try after I rewrote half the test suite at 2am.
I'm thankful for Mak packing extra nasi lemak for me to bring back to KL after the weekend.
I'm grateful for the office pantry still having kopi-O when the 4pm slump hit hard.
I'm thankful for finding a parking spot right outside the masjid with ten minutes to spare before Maghrib.
I'm grateful for a senior dev taking the time to actually explain the legacy code instead of just saying "don't touch it."
I'm thankful for the Grab driver who didn't mind the detour when the usual road was jammed solid.
I'm grateful for a bug report that came with an actual reproducible case, not just "it's broken."
I'm thankful for my phone battery lasting through a blackout that took out half the taman.
I'm grateful for the barber finally getting my fade right on the first attempt.
I'm thankful for a Friday khutbah that actually said something I'm still thinking about days later.
I'm grateful for the landlord fixing the leaking pipe same day instead of the usual two-week runaround.
I'm thankful for a code review comment that taught me something instead of just nitpicking semicolons.
I'm grateful for the kedai kopi uncle remembering my order without me having to say it.
I'm thankful for a quiet weekend with nothing on the calendar, just books and bad TV.
I'm grateful for the bonus hitting the account right as Raya shopping season kicked in.
